propositions: A declared-none file impact scope allows signed attestations to remain certified across unrelated commits without re-hashing dependencies or falling back to whole-HEAD freshness checks
The classifier distinguishes three cases: non-empty dependency paths (paths scope), explicitly declared none scope (none scope), and all other empty declarations (unscoped scope)

The manifest signing boundary reads effective file scope via rebar.get_file_impact_scope(), classifies the scope, and emits an authenticated file-scope: none declaration only for none-scoped records while preserving byte-for-byte compatibility with pre-feature paths and unscoped output

Validity computation skips code freshness when manifest is authenticated as none-scoped and dependencies are empty, continuing through material, phase, and relationship checks instead of returning stale-head

Material fingerprints for none-scoped records add a canonical JSON basis member containing file_impact_scope declaration and reason, making scope or reason changes result in stale-material verdicts while leaving legacy fingerprints unchanged
Recovery through resign_plan_review preserves authenticated none scope without new branches, and old readers treat unsigned file-scope lines as unscoped
